title: Limit values
description: The limit values that one grant gives (protocol 6.1). Each member name is the name of a limit. The value of a ceiling is a whole number. The value of a budget is an array of 1 to 4 items, one item for each window. A schema cannot check the rules that need the declaration, for example that the limit is declared. The tool access-lint checks them.

ceiling_value.description: The value of a ceiling: a whole number from min to max of the declaration.

budget_value.description: The value of a budget: one item for each window.

amount.description: The units for one window. A whole number from 1.

window.description: The fixed window in which the counter counts (protocol 6.3).
